# UX and Migration Checklist: Unified delegate pane

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements for pane layout, controls parity and installer migration are complete, clear and consistent before implementation (domain: ux-and-migration)
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Pane Layout and States

- [ ] CHK001 Is the pane title specified as more than "titled for agents-inc", given the contract names pane id `agents-inc-delegates`? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1-AS1, Contract]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the wording of the map's empty state specified, or only the tree and status-line empty texts? [Gap, Spec §US1-AS2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the placement of the "dispatch runs not visible" note within the section order (map, status line, feed, tree, form, message box) specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a freshness bound for tree and map updates after a delegate starts stated in the spec, not only the 1 s poll in the plan? [Gap, Plan §Design 2, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the rules for when a pending job row is replaced, kept, or timed out specified in the spec? [Gap, Plan §Design 3, Tasks T004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the display of a failed start (tree row state and where its stdout/stderr tail appears) specified in the spec? [Gap, Plan §R-d]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the number of finished runs the tree keeps (KEEP_RUNS = 8) and the rule for dropping older rows stated in the spec? [Gap, Tasks T004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the STALE and RECENT labels defined with their meaning and thresholds? [Clarity, Tasks T004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the map station category of a free-model run specified? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the rule for "the same delegate appears once in the tree and once on the map" (identity key: agent id, run dir name) stated in the spec rather than only in the plan? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §R3]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the pane's behavior when a poll read fails (for example `$.agent.list` errors) specified, separately from the refused-frame case? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Narrow Layout

- [ ] CHK012 Is the column width at which the map falls back to its static or one-line form quantified, or left to spec 039? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the default state of the narrow toggle (collapsed or expanded on first render) specified? [Gap, Plan §Design 5]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the behavior specified when the pane widens back above 34 columns while the toggle is open? [Gap, Plan §Design 5]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the collapsed toggle label specified in the spec, or only as "one-line toggle"? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Tasks T014]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "tree and map stay readable" at narrow width defined with a measurable criterion? [Measurability, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the persistence of the toggle state (session state versus stored state, reset at session start) specified in the spec? [Gap, Research R4, Tasks T003]

## Controls Parity

- [ ] CHK018 Is the parity baseline for the new-agent form (model list, effort list, defaults) written in the spec, given FR-006 points to agents-manager and Tasks T020 deletes that source? [Dependency, Spec §FR-006, Tasks T020]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the set of controls to keep an enumerated inventory, or does SC-002's "at least 10" leave other agents-manager controls unspecified? [Completeness, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the conditions under which cancel and ask-to-stop are shown or enabled (run states) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Is resume specified for finished native subagents, or only for finished runs? [Gap, Spec §US2-AS4]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the free-model message behavior stated consistently: "offers no message or cancel controls" (US2-AS3) versus "refuse with a note" (FR-007, Edge Cases)? [Conflict, Spec §US2-AS3, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the effort control's behavior for free-model runs specified (hidden, shown, or ignored)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK024 Are the form's default model and effort on first open specified now that the native types list is removed? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the operator-visible feedback for a successful and a failed native start specified? [Gap, Spec §US2-AS1]
- [ ] CHK026 Are non-pointer (keyboard) equivalents for row open, run sub-pane, cancel and send specified, or is their absence intended? [Gap, Spec §US2-AS5]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the lifecycle of a run sub-pane specified for when its run finishes or the pane closes? [Gap, Plan §Design 6]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the behavior of a Codex start specified when dispatch runs are not visible (the `.scratch` note case), since the edge case only says native still works? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Installer Migration

- [ ] CHK029 Is the installer's exit status and output specified when an uninstall of a retired mod fails on the first run? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Plan §R-c]
- [ ] CHK030 Does the spec resolve the stale luna-pane cache: User Story 3 expects only delegate-pane to remain, while Plan R-c puts cache removal out of scope? [Conflict, Spec §US3-Independent Test, Plan §R-c]
- [ ] CHK031 Are recovery requirements specified for a partial migration (old pane removed but delegate-pane update fails, or the reverse)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK032 Is a rollback path to the old panes specified, or is the removal intended to be one-way? [Gap, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it specified whether the merged pane replaces the running pane in the current session or only from the next session start? [Gap, Spec §US1, Quickstart step 4]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the retired marketplace names (`agents-manager-local`, `luna-pane-local`) stated in the spec, or only in the plan? [Traceability, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Design 8]
- [ ] CHK035 Is "a repeat run changes nothing and reports no error" defined measurably (exit status, no warning line, no CLI write calls)? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AS3, Plan §Design 8]
- [ ] CHK036 Is removal of the session-start `agents-inc luna status` spawn traced to a spec requirement? FR-008 covers only the lists. [Traceability, Gap, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Design 4]

## Repository Cleanup and Acceptance

- [ ] CHK037 Is the worktree removal gate stated with one commit count? Plan R-b says 10 commits on `fix/dispatch-non-git-cwd` not on development or main; Tasks T022 says 19. [Conflict, Spec §US4-AS3, Plan §R-b, Tasks T022]
- [ ] CHK038 Is SC-005 ("zero references outside history files") consistent with FR-011, which requires the installer to name the retired mods? The plan's grep allows the installer retired list and its test. [Conflict, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Design 8]
- [ ] CHK039 Does SC-003 cover read count? It measures test count only, while Tasks T027 cites it for the "no extra reads" check. [Traceability, Spec §SC-003, Tasks T027]
- [ ] CHK040 Is FR-014 ("no model call, no network") scoped to the pane process only, given that starting a free-model run triggers a model call? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §US2-AS3]
